description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'BusinessStepHelper' for managing business step configurations in integration tests for the Fineract project. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and restoring business step configurations, as well as an inner class representing a snapshot of steps.

classes.name: BusinessStepHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to retrieve, update, and restore business step configurations for integration tests.

classes.name: BusinessStepHelper.BusinessStepsSnapshot
classes.description: Inner class that captures a snapshot of business steps to allow restoration.

methods.name: getConfigurationSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the current business step configuration for a specified job.

methods.name: updateSteps
methods.description: Updates the business steps for a specified job with given step names.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the business step configuration to the snapshot state.
